notablePrerequisites: Spiteful Squad does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Spiteful Squad persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spiteful Squad, adding {C}{C}.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability and its second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its first ability.
Resolve the second trigger, putting the counters that were on Spiteful Squad when it died on another creature you control.
Repeat.
